finding: Revenue ledger is zero.
evidence_basis: data/ops/revenue-ledger-v1.json has entries_count 0 and no reported gross revenue.
recommended_action: Import affiliate commission reports and tie revenue to page, part, retailer, and click.

finding: Only 67 of 188 useful pages have valid buy CTAs.
evidence_basis: Business scorecard showed live_pages_with_valid_buy_cta 67 and zero_valid_buy_cta 121.
recommended_action: Run a CTA coverage sprint starting with refrigerator high-click pages.

finding: Commission truth is not connected to click truth.
evidence_basis: /go click tracking exists, affiliate click report has 242 raw clicks, revenue ledger has zero entries.
recommended_action: Build a revenue truth table joining page, part, retailer, click, tag, and commission.

finding: Organic traction is weak in available GSC data.
evidence_basis: GSC report showed 3 clicks, 289 impressions, average position 25.49.
recommended_action: Prioritize pages already getting impressions and build proof-rich content around them.

finding: Topical authority content is thin.
evidence_basis: Only 7 help markdown articles were found.
recommended_action: Build refrigerator filter and replacement-intent content clusters.

finding: Programmatic pages carry duplicate/thin-content risk.
evidence_basis: Large model/filter page surface is template-driven.
recommended_action: Index only pages with unique compatibility evidence, useful copy, and monetizable next action.

finding: Measurement artifacts are stale in places.
evidence_basis: Stored sitemap artifact showed old lastmod values and URLs inconsistent with launch state.
recommended_action: Add freshness warnings for sitemap, GSC, GA4, and report artifacts.

finding: Affiliate readiness is incomplete.
evidence_basis: Affiliate tracker: 22 programs, 3 approved, 5 rejected, many drafting/submitted/in review.
recommended_action: Finish high-value affiliate applications and verify tags.

finding: Refrigerator is the strongest commercial wedge.
evidence_basis: Affiliate click report: refrigerator 147 of 242 raw clicks.
recommended_action: Make refrigerator the first revenue focus.

finding: Air purifier has breadth but less proven commercial urgency.
evidence_basis: Air purifier has 572 models and 69 parts, but fewer clicks than refrigerator.
recommended_action: Keep live, but do not let it distract from refrigerator revenue work.

finding: Whole-house water appears in some readiness contexts despite noindex launch state.
evidence_basis: vertical-launch-state marks whole-house-water NOINDEX_UNPROVEN.
recommended_action: Keep noindex until search misses and proof gaps are resolved.

finding: Revenue forecasts should not be trusted until commission imports exist.
evidence_basis: Clicks exist but no commission ledger entries exist.
recommended_action: Suppress or caveat revenue forecasts until actual revenue data is connected.

finding: No clear current SERP/rank tracker was found.
evidence_basis: Reviewed repo evidence showed GSC artifacts but not durable daily rank tracking.
recommended_action: Add rank tracking for target pages and queries.

finding: Backlink and referral strategy is not proven.
evidence_basis: No strong referral, partner, or backlink engine appeared in reviewed evidence.
recommended_action: Build partner/referral outreach around proof-rich resources.

finding: Reddit and forum acquisition are not proven.
evidence_basis: No clear community acquisition system appeared in reviewed evidence.
recommended_action: Create a helpful-answer playbook for appliance and filter communities.

finding: AI-search strategy is not proven.
evidence_basis: No llms.txt or explicit answer-engine strategy was found.
recommended_action: Publish AI-readable evidence summaries and canonical compatibility pages.

finding: No retention/reminder product means repeat value is lost.
evidence_basis: No saved-home or reminder loop was found in reviewed evidence.
recommended_action: Build My Home Filters v1 with saved model and replacement reminders.

finding: EEAT/trust foundation exists but needs more public evidence density.
evidence_basis: About, Disclosure, Truth Policy, Wrong Part Prevention exist; Universal Trust Contract still flags gaps.
recommended_action: Add methodology, source trails, update history, and trust strips on key surfaces.

finding: Schema is conservative but under-leveraged.
evidence_basis: Structured data exists but appears limited.
recommended_action: Add Product, FAQ, Breadcrumb, and valid HowTo/schema coverage where supportable.

finding: Direct traffic attribution is unclear.
evidence_basis: Affiliate click referrers were mostly '(none)', which is not actionable acquisition truth.
recommended_action: Improve UTM/referrer/session attribution.

finding: Founder is the main operating bottleneck.
evidence_basis: Many systems require interpretation and manual prioritization.
recommended_action: Automate follow-up, freshness, CTA, revenue, and content-priority workflows.

finding: CEO dashboard is too operator/agent-heavy.
evidence_basis: Repo contains extensive command-center and agent-control reports.
recommended_action: Simplify CEO view around revenue, SEO, conversion, affiliate, and warnings.

finding: High-click pages need commercial treatment first.
evidence_basis: Affiliate click report lists specific top clicked refrigerator parts.
recommended_action: Upgrade top clicked pages with better CTAs, proof, seller comparison, and content.

finding: Social metadata exists, but social motion is not proven.
evidence_basis: Site social metadata files exist; no strong social acquisition evidence found.
recommended_action: Create YouTube, Reddit, and forum distribution experiments.

finding: The defensible moat is the compatibility evidence graph, not the app UI.
evidence_basis: Repo strength is compatibility, certainty, and evidence systems.
recommended_action: Invest in durable model-part-alias-seller-evidence-confidence infrastructure.
